title: A Cultural Observation
subtitle: Talking about cultural differences with a friend — for English learners

sentences.en: One thing I've noticed since moving here is that people tend to be very direct in conversation.
sentences.target: One thing I've noticed since moving here is that people tend to be very direct in conversation.

sentences.en: That's a pretty common observation, especially among people coming from more indirect cultures.
sentences.target: That's a pretty common observation, especially among people coming from more indirect cultures.

sentences.en: Back home, we often soften requests with extra phrases — here, people just say what they need.
sentences.target: Back home, we often soften requests with extra phrases — here, people just say what they need.

sentences.en: It can feel rude at first, but most of the time it's really just about being efficient.
sentences.target: It can feel rude at first, but most of the time it's really just about being efficient.

sentences.en: The dinner schedule has also taken some getting used to — eating at six feels very early to me.
sentences.target: The dinner schedule has also taken some getting used to — eating at six feels very early to me.

sentences.en: I get that. In a lot of countries, eight or nine in the evening is considered totally normal.
sentences.target: I get that. In a lot of countries, eight or nine in the evening is considered totally normal.

sentences.en: On the other hand, I really appreciate how seriously people here take their personal time.
sentences.target: On the other hand, I really appreciate how seriously people here take their personal time.

sentences.en: Yes, the boundary between work and personal life tends to be more clearly defined.
sentences.target: Yes, the boundary between work and personal life tends to be more clearly defined.

sentences.en: Even small things like tipping at restaurants took a while for me to feel comfortable with.
sentences.target: Even small things like tipping at restaurants took a while for me to feel comfortable with.

sentences.en: Cultural adjustment is gradual — it sounds like you're picking things up faster than you realize.
sentences.target: Cultural adjustment is gradual — it sounds like you're picking things up faster than you realize.

sentences.en: Thanks. It helps a lot to talk to someone who understands both perspectives.
